title: Hollow Knight
provenance: Reported by AYDJI (highball-db#106, 2026-09-17), Apple M4, macOS 27.0 as entered, Highball 0.9.6, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r0, graphics mode not stated, rated 4 of 5 (playable, minor issues) at 1080p 75 Hz. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: This game has a native macOS version on Steam, so the Mac Steam app runs it directly without Highball. The Windows build was reported playable through Highball at 1080p and 75 Hz, mode not stated, with an occasional keyboard issue. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Keyboard input drops once in a while (reported, Windows build through Highball)
knownIssues.fix: Not investigated. The native macOS version avoids Wine altogether.

knownIssues.symptom: Some cutscenes (the Nailsmith's, the Black Egg's) stay on a black screen (reported on an M4, DXMT, engine r5, highball#214).
knownIssues.cause: not measured. Hollow Knight plays its cutscenes as video files, which go through Wine's own media layer.
knownIssues.fix: the native Mac build plays them. Not investigated for the Windows build.
